looking up supplementary material for ML chapters

summary.what_it_does: The page is the supporting wiki for The Hundred-Page Machine Learning Book. It lists the book's chapters, grouped into supervised learning (chapters 2 to 8) and unsupervised and other forms of learning (chapters 9 to 11). Some chapters have extra in-depth material. The wiki extends chapters with Q&A, code snippets, further reading, tools and other resources. The author distributes the book on a "read first, buy later" basis, and says it is now sold on Amazon and other bookstores. The page also invites readers to join a mailing list for updates.
notable: Chapter-by-chapter wiki with Q&A, code snippets and further reading
Book distributed on a 'read first, buy later' basis
Covers supervised learning, neural networks, deep learning and unsupervised learning
caveats: The book itself is now sold commercially, so some content may require purchase
Wiki content is a supplement to the book and not a standalone course
